title.en: An Act Creating the Barrio of Tagabaca in the City of Butuan
title.orig: An Act Creating the Barrio of Tagabaca in the City of Butuan
title.vi: Đạo luật thành lập một Barrio Tagabaca tại Thành phố Butuan
title.th: พระราชบัญญัติจัดตั้งบาริโอ Tagabaca ในเมือง Butuan
title.id: Undang-Undang membentuk sebuah Barrio Tagabaca di Kota Butuan
title.ms: Akta menubuhkan sebuah Barrio Tagabaca di Bandar Butuan

source.name: LawPhil 菲律宾法律虚拟图书馆（The LawPhil Project – Arellano Law Foundation）

completenessNote: 全文，共 2 条；逐字取自 LawPhil 菲律宾法律虚拟图书馆（The LawPhil Project – Arellano Law Foundation） 官方页面（statutes/repacts/ra1959/ra_2194_1959.html），未改写、未摘译、未节选；原文语言：英语。 条文抬头依源文为 “Section N.” 等形式，本库统一规范为 “Section N.”；首行抬头与条内标题的分段依源文块级边界还原。

text.en: The sitio of Tagabaca in the City of Butuan is converted into a barrio of said city to be known as the barrio of Tagabaca.

This Act shall take effect upon its approval.
Approved: May 7, 1959.
